notes: wall and CPU are measured by the bash time keyword around each command; CPU is user plus system of the command and every descendant it waited for.
zmx2's own 'cpu' figure is the sum of per-root elapsed times, not processor time.
OUT paths in the commands are session scratch directories outside the packet; the retained copies are named in each receipt entry.
The receipt headers of the zmx2-only commands originally named the interpreter wrapper; that line was corrected to say python3 is not used.
